products.name: Nutrilite Weight Management Shake Mix (Vanilla Flavor)
products.usp: Calorie-controlled clinical meal replacement delivering 25 vitamins & minerals, multi-source fiber, and Garcinia cambogia (60% HCA) for sustained satiety and metabolic management.

clinical_nutrition_rationale.what_it_is: A clinically formulated meal-replacement powder designed to substitute 1 to 2 standard meals daily. When reconstituted with 300ml of skimmed milk (or water with 1 scoop of All Plant Protein), each serving delivers approximately 200-220 kcal, 14-16g of high-biological-value protein, 4.5-5.5g of soluble and insoluble dietary fiber (Oat, Chicory Inulin, and Corn Dextrin), 25 essential vitamins and minerals at ~30% daily RDA, and botanical *Garcinia cambogia* extract standardized to 60% Hydroxycitric Acid (HCA).
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: Conventional calorie-restriction diets almost universally fail because unmanaged caloric deficits cause extreme hunger (elevated circulating ghrelin), metabolic rate slowdown, and severe micronutrient starvation. Furthermore, low-protein crash diets cause patients to lose lean muscle mass rather than visceral adipose tissue. Nutrilite Weight Management Shake solves this: the dual protein and triple fiber matrix creates physical gastric distension and stimulates intestinal peptide YY (PYY) and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) release to suppress appetite naturally. Standardized HCA competitively inhibits ATP-citrate lyase, an essential enzyme in de novo lipogenesis (fat synthesis), while the 25 vitamins and minerals prevent the fatigue, hair loss, and immune suppression characteristic of poorly planned weight-loss programs.

Reconstituted with skimmed milk, it provides ~210 kcal, 15g protein, 5g prebiotic fiber blend, 25 micronutrients at 30% RDA, and standardized *Garcinia cambogia* extract, sweetened with non-nutritive steviol glycosides and sucralose.
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: Dietary adherence is the single greatest determinant of successful weight management. Craving palatable, high-sugar, high-fat sweet foods (particularly chocolate) is the primary trigger for diet abandonment and binge-eating episodes. This chocolate meal replacement satisfies neural reward pathways without delivering the 500+ calories and high sugar found in commercial chocolate desserts. The cocoa polyphenols supply antioxidant flavonoids that support vascular nitric oxide production, while the protein-fiber-HCA triad blunts hunger and keeps the individual fully focused throughout the working day.

products.name: NUTRILITE® Fiber
products.usp: Triple soluble prebiotic fiber blend (Resistant Maltodextrin, Inulin, Partially Hydrolyzed Guar Gum) that dissolves completely clear and tasteless in any beverage or food.

clinical_nutrition_rationale.what_it_is: A targeted soluble prebiotic dietary fiber formulation composed of three non-viscous, non-gelling dietary fibers: Resistant Maltodextrin (Fibersol-2), Chicory Root Inulin, and Partially Hydrolyzed Guar Gum (PHGG). Each 4.5g scoop yields 3.7g of pure soluble prebiotic fiber. It dissolves completely crystal clear in water or food without changing the flavor, color, or texture, and is thermally stable.
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: Modern refined diets are stripped of dietary fiber (average urban Indian consumes only 12-15g/day vs clinical recommendations of 30-40g/day). Fiber deficiency leads to dysbiosis, sluggish bowel transit, constipation, elevated LDL cholesterol, and exaggerated postprandial glucose excursions. Traditional insoluble fibers (like raw bran or psyllium) can cause severe gas, clumping, and choking hazards. Nutrilite Fiber solves this: its triple soluble matrix passes through the upper GI tract intact, binding excess bile acids in the jejunum to lower circulating cholesterol. In the colon, it undergoes slow, non-cramping fermentation by *Bifidobacteria* into Short-Chain Fatty Acids (SCFAs: acetate, propionate, butyrate), which reinforce mucosal barrier integrity, improve insulin sensitivity, and promote regular, painless bowel movements.
